title: Hit Crossing
text: Detect crossing point, 1 input, 5 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Hit crossing direction} sets Input signal direction to hit crossing; {Hit crossing offset} sets the hit crossing value for detection, {Show output port} displays an output port, {Output type} sets the signal, message, or function-call output and {Enable zero-crossing detection}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | message | function-call event

ports.name: CrossingType
ports.summary: Direction of zero-crossing None | NegativeToPositive | NegativeToZero | ZeroToPositive | PositiveToNegative | PositiveToZero | ZeroToNegative

ports.name: Index
ports.summary: Index of the input signal at which the hit crossing event occurs nonnegative integer

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time of hit crossing event real, finite

ports.name: Offset
ports.summary: Hit crossing value for detection 0 (default) | real values

params.name: Hit crossing offset
params.values: Hit crossing value for detection 0 (default) | real values

params.name: Hit crossing direction
params.values: Input signal direction to hit crossing either (default) | falling | rising

params.name: Show output port
params.values: Display an output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output type
params.values: Choose signal, message, or function-call output Signal (default for Simulink ® ) | Message (default for SimEvents) | Function-Call
